note: A network meta-analysis counts every trial in the network. Only the DIRECT comparison of our question (denosumab vs placebo) is comparable to our trial set; network-wide counts are recorded beside it and are never used as the comparator's k for overlap.

whole_network.quote: This network meta-analysis included 92 RCTs involving 145 516 postmenopausal women with osteoporosis treated with sixteen kinds of pharmacologic therapies.

outcome_network.quote: Fifty-five RCTs (n = 104 580) evaluating vertebral fractures of sixteen kinds of pharmacologic therapies were included in the network meta-analysis.

direct_comparison.why: the comparator's per-comparison trial list and direct-comparison forest plots are in its online Supplement (eFigures/eTables), which is not held; the main text reports the network estimate only
